key_decisions: TWO CHANGELOG ENTRIES ARE OWED AND WERE DELIBERATELY HELD, under the repo's own rule that a line for something that has not run is worse than no line: (a) the NAG negative fix — LTX's negative prompt genuinely did nothing before today, which is a significant user-facing fix; (b) MPI-474's audio negative. Both are held ONLY until a run completes. The last-frame pill entry is NOT held any more — end-only ran, so it is proposal 2 above.

Input_Negative_Audio is injected EVEN WHEN EMPTY. The graph gates NAG on the string being non-empty, so a cleared box must reach the node to switch NAG back off. Do not 'optimise' this to a conditional injection.

The audio stop is gated on capabilities.audio — the same signal that surfaces the audio input slot and the audioMode/useAudio controls, so the three can never disagree. A model without it cycles two ways exactly as before.

MpiButton is strictly boolean (toggleable/iconActive are a CSS swap on is-active), so the cycle mounts NOT toggleable and drives setActive/setIcon by hand. setIcon was added for this and mirrors setLabel.
The user chose the single cycling button over a text field in the controls row. A controls-row input would have been the first of its kind and the wrong home; the box already IS the text field.
The engine wipe that broke ffmpeg is ALREADY FIXED by the parallel session (6856d841, '.disabled node folder is not a deprecation'). Do not re-diagnose it.

Preview_Only: an earlier session left it, reasoning the guard 'still protects every other model'. That was wrong — zero graphs have the node. Corrected in MPI-473's brief; do not re-adopt the old reasoning.
